g.text: All 22,309 AMCB certificants. The strata partition the roster exactly; each loses one more property
than the one to its left. Bar labels are totals; boxed labels are the actively certified subset.
What each linkage stratum has, and what it lacks
Properties are tested in order; a stratum holds a strict prefix of them, so the matrix is a staircase rather than a lattice.
Tied names and unruled-out component share a pattern: they are indistinguishable on these five properties, which is why
reporting the 5,411 unresolved as one number hides four different causes. Contested NPIs resolve uniquely and are pruned
by the one-to-one constraint, so they sit above tied names. Source: artifacts/linkage_completeness_by_status.csv
